title: Impossible, terrifying cavernous hall inside a multi storey building??
content: So i visited this place in a dream that still haunts me to this day and I'd like to know if anyone can relate. i was high up in a tall old fashioned multi story building, similar to the balmoral in edinbugh, but taller. I was supposed to olay a concert from the balcony, but i couldn't do it because im badly effected by veritgo. I left ths place where the balcony was, and walked along red carpeted halls to this room through a door. It was an impossibly big, square cavernous room, that reminds me of the great hall from Moria (pictured) but without the pillars in the middle. In the centre of the room was a large fissure, it was not possible to tell how deep it was. High up the wall opposite the entrance were large sigils that glowed like the moon, and maybe even depicted a moon cycle? In this room i experienced the purest and most primal fear i have ever felt. There wasnt anything in there, it was very still. But it terrified me in a way that i have never been scared before or since. It stayed with me for weeks after, and even now as i type this (6 months after the dream) im getting a little feart. Does this sound familiar to anyone??
